info.title: Ralysa control plane
info.description: Generated from services/control-plane/src/http/contracts.ts. No route accepts a user-held shared secret (AC-3).

get.summary: Flow B leg 1 (/login --browser): sets the browser-binding cookie and redirects to the IdP. An unknown client or a non-loopback redirect_uri is never redirected (RFC 6749 §4.1.2.1).

302.description: To the IdP, or back to the loopback with an OAuth error

400.description: Plain-text en/ar error: invalid client or redirect URI

get.summary: Flow B leg 2: the IdP's redirect. Consumes the stored request, checks the browser-binding cookie, redeems the IdP code and redirects to the loopback with a single-use rly_ac_ code (or an OAuth error).

302.description: To the loopback with `code` and `state`, or `error` and `error_description` (a sign-in reason)

400.description: Plain-text en/ar error: unknown request or browser binding failed

post.summary: RFC 7009 revocation = sign-out: revokes the refresh token's whole session

200.description: Revoked, or the token was unknown (RFC 7009)

post.summary: Token endpoint: authorization_code with PKCE (flow B), token exchange of an IdP device-flow access token (RFC 8693), refresh_token and client_credentials (private_key_jwt). No client secret is ever accepted.

400.description: invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_scope, unauthorized_client (device code switched off), access_denied (sign-in refused by policy) or unsupported_grant_type

503.description: temporarily_unavailable (IdP directory, token signing or audit unavailable; a refresh token is not consumed)

get.summary: Readiness: database, an active signing key, no custody violation

post.summary: Client-attested local-tool audit (AC-16): the actor, org, source and ts come from the token and the server; server-issued sessions bound to the token's sid; client_seq gaps; each tool.call.requested is answered with an intent ack (refused while a kill-switch applies).

201.description: Stored or duplicate, with intent acks

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked access token

409.description: A new session not opened by session.started, or an unknown, foreign or ended session, or a client_seq at or below the last one outside an open gap

413.description: An event over 4 KB (canonical form) or a body over 256 KB

422.description: Schema, allow-list, reserved details key or I-JSON

423.description: A kill-switch covers an intent: halted, ack false, stored as tool.call.denied

429.description: More than 20 open sessions for the auth session, or 600 events a minute

503.description: audit_unavailable: nothing stored, every intent ack false

post.summary: Service audit ingestion (AC-11): 1–100 events, each within the calling service's action allow-list; source from the service token, attestation server, ts from the database clock. A plain INSERT per event in a savepoint (duplicate event_id = duplicate). auth.token_rejected reports are aggregated per client network (status aggregated).

201.description: Stored, duplicate or aggregated, per event

403.description: A user token, an unregistered service, or an action outside the allow-list (audited as audit.ingest_rejected)

422.description: Schema, I-JSON details, outcome rule or unknown user actor

503.description: audit_unavailable: the insert failed or exceeded 250 ms

get.summary: Audit query (AC-12): session role platform_admin and a current admin-group membership; audit.query is committed before any result is read; keyset paging on (ts, event_id), not a snapshot: an event committed late with a ts before the last key already read is not on the next page, and re-running the query over the same range returns it

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Exclusive end (RFC 3339), at most 31 days after from

200.description: A page of events with their seals

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked access token

403.description: Not a platform admin (audited as audit.query denied)

503.description: audit_unavailable: audit.query could not be committed

get.summary: Enabled CLI sign-in flows and IdP endpoints

post.summary: Client-reported IdP-side failures of the device flow (AC-4): audited as auth.sign_in failure, idempotent per attempt_id, rate-limited and aggregated

get.summary: Revocations, kill-switch state and epoch for every PEP (service token; G-1)

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The cursor of the previous response; without it the feed covers the maximum access-token TTL + 5 min

get.summary: Groups, roles and status of a user (service token)
The signed-in user, the calling session's roles and the user's groups

401.description: Missing, invalid or revoked access token
